decision: Store the last Gmail history record id when a page has nextPageToken, and chain another sync.
why: The response historyId is the mailbox tip. Saving it after one page skips every later page.

decision: Sync any Gmail mailbox whose lastSyncedAt is older than 60s, including error.
why: syncNow skipped status error, so one failure stopped mail until reconnect. Comment review asked for the same cooldown.

decision: Merge gmailLabelIds inside the patch mutation and send only the new key.
why: Two actions each wrote a full map, so the later write dropped the other category.

decision: Put base64 padding back on reply subjects and bodies.
why: utf8Base64 stripped equals signs. A strict parser rejects that. Gmail raw send still uses unpadded base64url.
evidence: tests/sync-bugs.test.ts buildMime; old encoder emitted SGk

decision: Saturday morning This weekend stays today at 9:00. Share SNOOZE_MIN_MS with the server check.

decision: Say 30 days on the connect banner, clear the newest backfill runs, and show a route error when a message query throws.

decision: pnpm tsc, convex tsc, eslint, node tests, and vite build.

decision: Follow nextPageToken until a history record id shows up, then stop.
